prompt:
S#1 환영 시퀀스 – 몽타주 (애니매이션)
바닷속 도시. 유리와 빛으로 된 건축.
그 속에서 유영하는 또 다른 인류.
빛은 교회나 성당에 있는 스테인드글라스처럼 색색으로 일렁인다.
윤호, 숨소리가 잦아들며 두려움이 경이로움으로 바뀐다.
바닷속 도시를 헤엄치면서 그의 눈동자에 환영이 비친다.
윤호의 눈에서 화면이 왜곡되며 흰색 플래시.

S#2 윤호 방 (밤 / 안)
윤호는 똑같은 물고기 인간을 쳐다본다.
그 물고기 인간은 이제는 윤호의 이마에 손을 대려고 한다.
환상을 이미 경험한 윤호는 눈을 감으며 모든 것을 맡긴다.
화면이 왜곡되며 블루 플래시.

environment.overview: Contemporary animated architecture combines slender luminous glass structures with a plain plaster-and-wood bedroom, using charcoal-to-pearl-gray values, soft nocturnal illumination, and stained-glass-like jewel colors within the underwater light.
environment.location_type: A submerged city exterior and open-water architectural court, followed by an indoor bedroom connected only through the vision transition.

zones.name: Glass Avenue
zones.description: A broad submerged avenue paved with pale glass slabs, tall transparent buildings with narrow vertical ribs, projecting glass buttresses, suspended particles, and dark open water overhead; an open arch at the avenue’s end reveals the columns of Prismatic Court

zones.name: Prismatic Court
zones.description: A roofless submerged court with a translucent tiled floor, tall glass columns, freestanding pointed arch frames, and vertical translucent panels casting overlapping jewel-colored light; Glass Avenue is visible through the entrance arch

zones.name: Yunho's Bedroom
zones.description: A narrow bed with a low wooden headboard, pale sheets and a charcoal-edged blanket, matte light-gray plaster walls, a small curtained window, a plain wooden desk beneath it, and a closed wooden door; there is standing space beside the bed

baseline.weather: calm conditions, clear water in the vision, no visible precipitation outside the bedroom
baseline.lighting: low pearl-gray underwater fill with softly luminous colored glass; dim, cool window light in the bedroom.

breakdown.logline: Frightened Yunho seeks to understand a strange fish-human, swimming through a radiant underwater city that turns his fear into wonder before a white flash returns him to his bedroom, where he closes his eyes and accepts the creature’s approaching hand as the room dissolves into blue light.

beats.summary: An underwater city reveals another humanity moving freely through its luminous architecture
The fish-human’s calm presence allows Yunho’s breathing to settle and his fear to soften
Yunho willingly explores the city, its stained-glass radiance gathering in his eye
The vision reflected in Yunho’s eye distorts and disappears into a white flash
In his bedroom, Yunho recognizes the same fish-human as its hand approaches his forehead
Yunho closes his eyes in surrender, and the room warps into a blue flash

subjects.name: Yunho
subjects.appearance: slender build, short charcoal hair, loose pale-gray long-sleeved sleep shirt, mid-gray ankle-length trousers, bare feet
signature_features: narrow limbs beneath a conspicuously oversized shirt create a recognizable silhouette from front, side, or rear.

subjects.name: Fish-human
subjects.appearance: tall, barrel-chested body with medium-gray scales, long heavy forearms, oversized webbed hands, broad bare feet, dark widely spaced eyes, and a low fin crest running from crown to upper back
signature_features: the bulky torso and disproportionately long forearms remain recognizable from any angle; a pale crescent marking surrounds the left eye.

subjects.name: Undersea swimmers
subjects.kind: A fixed trio of amphibious city inhabitants
subjects.appearance: pale-gray bodies, compact torsos, long limbs, small webbed hands, and ribbonlike calf fins; one tall, one medium-height, and one short
signature_features: their stepped height arrangement and long trailing calf fins distinguish the trio from every viewing direction.

spec.shot_name: Yunho entering the submerged city
spec.backdrop: Transparent towers and ribbed buttresses flank the glass avenue; dark open water fills the upper frame, and the entrance to Prismatic Court stands in the distance.
spec.action: Yunho swims toward frame right with rigid shoulders and arms held close; farther along the avenue, the three swimmers glide freely between the buildings.
spec.transition: Hard cut closer to the swimmers.
